content:
aisha: Candidate build rc-2026-03-23-4 is uploaded: gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-4. I opened the smoke job and the initial tests passed. Targeting the 22:00 UTC change window. release-notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-4

carl: ack. can you paste the artifact sha and the config pin?

aisha: sha256:9f3b2c1, config: infra:v12 (pinned). DB migration flag is off; no DB changes.

maya: quick checklist pls: k8s manifests, kv-warm, canary routes, telemetry hooks?

aisha: 1) k8s image set, 2) kv-warm job queued (job id 5234), 3) canary traffic set to 5%, 4) telemetry dashboards are templated (link in release notes).

carl: ops-sheriff, you on call for the window? if not, who is covering night? @ops-sheriff

ops-sheriff: i'll be on for the 22:00 window. assigned runbook: /runbooks/rc-promo. fallback sheriff is maya.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] queued staging->prod promotion request by aisha for image rc-4. Prechecks: CI: pass, Security scan: pass, KV warm: queued. ETA: 20m to canary start.

aisha: quick smoke logs from staging below:
```
2026-03-23T18:12:03Z INFO Starting service
2026-03-23T18:12:06Z INFO KV cache warm successful
2026-03-23T18:12:10Z INFO Healthcheck OK
```

carl: looks good. what are rollback criteria? need explicit triggers.

aisha: rollback if: 1) 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m, 2) p99 latency increase > 200ms over baseline for 10m, 3) error budget consume > 30% in 15m. If triggered we'll pin traffic back to rc-3 and trigger image rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-3`

maya: agree. add quick check: embedding service error rate up >1% (separate downstream) -> rollback.

ops-sheriff: documented. also add alert channel #incidents and oncall paging in runbook.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary promotion at 22:00 UTC scheduled. Canary ramp plan: 5% -> 20% over 10m -> 50% over next 15m -> full on green. Auto-abort on metric gates (5xx or latency).

aisha: last ask: are there any feature flags we need to keep closed? env flags: ENABLE_NEW_DECODER=false (will flip once at 100%).

carl: release notes look good. I'm 👍 for go. any docs updates?

aisha: release-notes updated with QA thumbs, migration notes, rollback commands. docs PR #789 merged.

maya: I'll watch the canary and validate end-to-end prompts after 20% ramp.

ops-sheriff: all clear from compliance side. KMS keys verified for private logs.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary job started at 22:00:05 UTC. Instance group: rc-4-canary (3 pods). Traffic routed: 5%

aisha: sanity checks show no errors at 5%. p50/p95/p99 within baseline.

maya: starting E2E smoke (synth prompts). results: pass 28/30, 2 transient timeouts (retriable).

carl: ok ramp to 20% when ready. ops-sheriff, give green for ramp?

ops-sheriff: green for ramp. Proceed.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 20% at 22:12 UTC.

aisha: metrics after 10m at 20%: 5xx = 0.03%, p99 +40ms — within threshold. embeddings downstream at 0.4% err.

maya: verified prompt quality spot-check samples. no regressions noted.

carl: i'm going to prepare the prod tag pin and release note blurb for the changelog.

aisha: schedule full promotion for 22:40 if no gates trip. We'll only flip ENABLE_NEW_DECODER after full promotion and a separate small bake.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 50% at 22:22 UTC.

ops-sheriff: monitoring. set a manual hold at 50% for 10m to eyeball traces.

aisha: holding and watching APM traces, no error hotspots.

maya: E2E pass at 50% (all 60 samples).

carl: preparing final command for full promote: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-4 && kubectl patch cm release-pin -p '{"data":{"current":"rc-4"}}'`

ops-sheriff: if anything goes sideways we run: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-3` and roll traffic back. Also enable deadman switch in deploy-bot to auto-fallback after 5m if metric gates fail.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promoting to 100% at 22:40:10 UTC. Pre-promotion check: all gates green.

aisha: hitting the promote command now.

maya: seeing gradual traffic shift.

carl: update release pin in infra. done. changelog posted.

ops-sheriff: keep monitoring for 30m. oncall page open.

aisha: marked RC promoted and release notes published. congrats team :tada:

maya: nice work. i'll follow-up with a short postmortem-style note in #eng-releases in 24h with perf deltas.

carl: closing thread. tagging retention: rc-4, promoted-by=aisha, sheriff=ops-sheriff.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete at 22:41:05 UTC. Live image: gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-4.

ops-sheriff: post-promo status at +15m: p99 +30ms, 5xx 0.02%. stable.

aisha: locking the change window. thanks all.
